blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Gilas Pilipinas secured a spot in the gold medal match of the women’s U-23 3×3 basketball of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games after defeating Thailand, 13-8, in Friday’s semifinals at Kinjo Futo Station Square. Maria Pasilang and Kennan Ka keyed a dominant display by the Philippine halfcourt ladies in beating their Southeast Asian foe and setting up a showdown with host Japan in the final to be held later in the day.
